summary: DOM verification of the P1 core-SOC migration wave. PASS: Detections (NxFilter + table + active-filter chips), Investigations list, Control Center (raw token leaks cleared), Clients, Event Explorer, LIGHT-theme contrast 0 failures on 6 routes, and 11 non-migrated routes still mount. defects.finding: Landed on /xdr/incidents/<caseId> which answers fail-closed; the 8-tab workspace rail was never mounted.
defects.root_cause: A case id is not an incident id. The list navigated to the incident route, so cases without a same-id incident dead-ended on the deliberate 'existence is never disclosed' page.
defects.fix: XdrInvestigationsListPage.open() now navigates to /xdr/investigations/<caseId>/_engine?tab=story (the surface that renders a case).

defects.finding: Raw tokens WAITING_APPROVAL and VITE_XDR_RESPONSE_URL visible; no xdr-approvals-state-*, no xdr-approvals-empty.
defects.root_cause: The page short-circuited to a bespoke 'NOT WIRED' block before the migrated list; prose also printed machine tokens.
defects.fix: Not-wired block replaced with NxSection + NxState(NOT_CONFIGURED) stating the queue is UNKNOWN rather than empty; prose de-tokenised.

defects.finding: evidence-table absent; bespoke 'NO MATCHING EVIDENCE' block rendered instead.
defects.root_cause: Same short-circuit pattern: a hand-built empty block replaced the table, so the column contract disappeared exactly when the analyst needed to see what was searched.
defects.fix: The platform table now always renders and owns its empty state.

defects.finding: xdr-rules-table / xdr-playbooks-table absent when the store is empty.
defects.fix: Tables render alongside the not-wired section; their own empty state replaces the bespoke block.
